current_answer: AWS Activate’s standard application requires a Paid account plan, not a stated premium Support subscription. The optional AI-agent page still says “paid support plan”; AWS has not reconciled that wording. Basic Support is included, while Business Support+ currently starts at USD 29 per month per account or a higher usage-based charge. Ask AWS before buying Support for the agent route. NLnet CodeSupply’s 3 November call remains live.

catalogue_card.question: Do AWS Activate applicants need to buy Support?
catalogue_card.text: The standard route names a Paid AWS account. The optional AI-agent page says “paid support plan,” but AWS has not clarified whether that means an extra subscription. Basic Support is included; Business Support+ starts at USD 29/month. Ask before paying.

summary: AWS Billing distinguishes Paid account plans from premium Support; Free accounts cannot receive other promotional credits.
The agent-assisted page still says “paid support plan,” while the main Activate page says “Paid Tier Plan.”
AWS lists a USD 29 monthly Business Support+ minimum or a higher percentage charge, with a 30-day minimum commitment.
NLnet CodeSupply’s 3 November 2026, 12:00 CET call and shared form remain live.
uncertainty: AWS has not clarified whether a paid Support subscription is required for the optional agent-assisted route.
No signed-in Activate application, support subscription or account-specific credit was tested.
CodeSupply applicant-specific eligibility and award remain unknown; first-party analytics are unavailable.
